intro.heading: Building from source
intro.summary: Build LIMEN's native components with CMake. The scripts configure the toolchain and compile the native modules.
quick-build.heading: Run the build
quick-build.paragraph: For a separate debug build, pass --config Debug:
hashlink.heading: HashLink source path
hashlink.paragraph: The script looks for ../hashlink-nmb by default. If your sources are elsewhere, pass the path explicitly.
output.heading: Build outputs
output.paragraph: After the build finishes, open build/bin/<platform>-<configuration>. Apps that only need windows require limen.hdll. The graphics backend you choose determines which other modules to include.
